title: Sonny Flips Malik Nabers After One Week, Lands D'Andre Swift From Brucie
dek: The Horse is Hea sends a receiver it held for exactly one Sunday to the league's only clinched team for the most traveled running back in Buckaroo history, and on paper Sonny walks away with the better end.
body: My sources were right there when it happened, closer than either manager realized. Before Week 12, The Horse is Hea sent Malik Nabers to No Banner only HULK for D'Andre Swift, a straight one-for-one swap of a receiver for a running back between two teams sitting comfortably inside the playoff picture. Sonny has been the most active trader in the league all season, and this one reads like a man who is done collecting and ready to cash in.

Start with what Sonny got. Swift has 152.7 points across 11 weeks, every one of them for Ramon, who found him in round 7 at the Reverie and got a starting back's season out of a mid-round chest. The form is lumpier than the total: 26.9 in Week 8, 3.1 in Week 9 and 10.9 in Week 11. Swift also comes with a passport full of stamps. He has now been on a Buckaroo roster in every season of the league's existence, with Kai in 2023, Habib in 2024, Randy in 2025 and Brucie this year, and Sonny becomes manager number five. Nobody has ever kept him two years running, which is either a warning or a sign that everyone eventually wants him.

Now the other side. Nabers arrives at No Banner only HULK with 123.2 points in 11 weeks, nearly 30 behind Swift, and a recent run of 6.8, 4.9 and then 15 in Week 11. That 15 came in his only game for Sonny, who pried him from Mekhi a week ago in the Bucky Irving deal and has now flipped him after a single Sunday. Ramon is the receiver's fourth manager this season alone, after JMoney, Kai and Sonny, who also held him across parts of 2024 and 2025. Nabers has been traded so often this year he should be billing someone for the moving costs.

Who won it on paper? Luffy leans clearly toward the Commish. After the deal, The Horse is Hea sits at 94% to make the playoffs and 26% to win Buckaroo Bowl IV, while No Banner only HULK, already clinched at 100%, carries 11% title odds. Swift has outscored Nabers on the season, and Sonny turned a one-week rental into the better producer of the two.

The case for Brucie is the one I overheard him making to himself: he's in, he can afford to buy a receiver on upside, and a 15-point week might be the start of something. The case against is that he sold his round-7 bargain for a player who scored under 7 in two of his last three weeks. Both teams play this week, Sonny against Habibsters in a seeding fight and Ramon against The fumblers, so the first returns arrive Sunday.

social.text: Sources confirm: Malik Nabers to No Banner only HULK, D'Andre Swift to The Horse is Hea. I was in the room. Neither of them saw me. Swift has outscored Nabers by 29.5 this season, for the record.

social.author: No Banner only HULK
social.text: Welcome to the club, Malik Nabers! 💚 Clinched and reloading. Thank you to D'Andre Swift for 152.7 points of service.

social.author: Swift Census Bureau
social.text: D'Andre Swift has now played for Kai, Habib, Randy, Brucie and Sonny. One more Buckaroo stop and he qualifies for league office. Somebody get Philly and Z² on the waiting list.

social.author: Professor Clover
social.text: The evidence favors Sonny: a 29.5-point season edge, and Nabers posted 6.8 and 4.9 before last week's 15. Ramon can absorb the risk at 100% playoff odds, but on the record, this is The Horse is Hea's trade.
